rows.Name: Experience scroll
rows.Description: A booster that increases experience gain by 100%.; The effect lasts for 30 minutes.

rows.Name: Ingredients Scroll
rows.Description: A booster that increases the number of ALCHEMICAL INGREDIENTS acquired from monsters and plants by 100%.; The effect lasts for 30 minutes.

rows.Name: Range scroll
rows.Description: Increases map interaction range by 50%.; The effect lasts for 30 minutes.

rows.Name: Summoning Scroll
rows.Description: Summons 5 random monsters, including 4 common and 1 common or rare.
